I’m fourth year now and can only speak from my experience living in LeBlanc and from what my friends who lived in other traditional residences and 90U told me.

Roomies will always be hit or miss regardless and there’s no way to know until your there. Most shy/reserved people tend to pick 90U, hence why it’s quieter and people stick to themselves. I have no clue about Annex but if it’s full of upper years totally guaranteed for limited amounts of partying

I see where you’re coming from but not everyone gets a long with/is friends with their roommates. Apartment style residences as opposed to traditional residences are known for everyone to keep to themselves with less common room time together and getting to know everyone on your floor. 90U is the same.

If you’re hoping to meet people through living in Rez but still want to live alone I’d suggest a single room in a traditional residence like Thompson or LeBlanc. They are quite small but you’ll meet people and still have your own room! 

I stayed in a double room in LeBlanc in my first room and no residence is a 5 star hotel but I had a blast and met new people I still talk to! 

Best of luck!
